node.label: Non-acidotic proximal tubulopathy
node.definition: A type of proximal renal tubulopathy characterized by resorption defects leading to glycosuria, aminoaciduria, tubular proteinuria, renal hypophosphatemia, and urate tubular hyporeabsorption without bicarbonate loss.

evidence.snippet: Dent disease: Non-acidotic proximal tubulopathy (frequency HP:0040281) [TAS]
